title: Plano-mae e ancoragem operacional
description: Anchor the legacy Admin V0.2 frame plan inside Agentic Ops before generating implementation work.
objective: Make the plan executable by another AI through explicit preset, boundaries, sequence, and continuity criteria.
acceptance_criteria: The plan states that .agentic-ops/ must be initialized in overlay mode.
The plan explains what must still work after the user stops explaining context.
verification: Run MCP validate_plan on this artifact.
MCP inspect_workspace returned overlay before init

budgets.context_budget: AGENTS, source-of-truth, frame plan, Agentic Ops MCP reference
budgets.iteration_budget: one adaptation pass plus validation fixes

risks: The plan may become too broad if all 28 frames are treated as one implementation batch.
Agentic Ops overlay may conflict with the repository root containment rule unless explicitly accepted.

tests.objective: Confirm the operational plan is schema-valid enough for Agentic Ops MCP use.
preconditions: Agentic Ops MCP validate_plan tool is available.
steps: Call mcp__agentic_ops__.validate_plan with this plan object.
Fix required errors before implementation starts.
tests.expected_result: The plan validates with no blocking schema errors.

subtasks.title: Record overlay mode
subtasks.description: Use MCP inspection output to document overlay mode and overwrite risks.
subtasks.objective: Prevent Agentic Ops from replacing existing instructions.
